alerts.description:

hottest days ranging from around 90 near the coast to the upper 90s
to 108 for the valleys possible. Low temperatures for coastal areas
into the western valleys will warm into the lower to mid 70s during

next week.

alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 30 at 2:02AM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected due to high tides and
high baseline water levels.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT today.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides, most likely between 11 AM and 1 PM.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides are expected to peak between
6.9 and 7.1 feet between 11 AM and 1 PM today. These tide
predictions have been corrected to reflect current trends in
observed tide observations.
